action_instruction: Checking product price formatting on the current page
intent: whether every product price displayed in the cart page main content uses US dollar notation with two decimal places

action_params.condition: Every product price on the current page is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00.
action_params.query: whether every product price displayed in the cart page main content uses US dollar notation with two decimal places
action_params.code_js: (() => { const text = el(11).innerText; const amounts = text.match(/\$\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g) || []; return amounts.every(x => /^\$\d+\.\d{2}$/.test(x)); })()

action_instruction: Checking cart and order amount formatting
intent: whether every monetary amount displayed in the cart or order summary in the main content uses US dollar notation with two decimal places

action_params.condition: Every amount in a cart or order summary on the current page is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00, except shipping may say Free.
action_params.query: whether every monetary amount displayed in the cart or order summary in the main content uses US dollar notation with two decimal places
action_params.code_js: (() => { const text = el(11).innerText; const amounts = text.match(/\$\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g) || []; return amounts.every(x => /^\$\d+\.\d{2}$/.test(x)); })()

assertion_tree.description: every product price, and every amount in a cart or order summary, is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00 (shipping may say Free)

sub_results.description: Every product price on the current page is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00.
Every amount in a cart or order summary on the current page is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00, except shipping may say Free.

assertion_tree.verification: Product prices and amounts in any cart or order summary on the current page follow the stated US-dollar formatting rule.
